faqs.a:
Regular and probationary employees are requested to give the appointing authority
               at least 14 calendar days' prior notice, unless the appointing authority agrees to
               permit a lesser period of time. A written resignation giving the reasons for leaving
               shall be submitted by the employee to the appointing authority. The appointing authority
               will forward the resignation to the human resources department. A resignation may
               be approved verbally by the employee's immediate supervisor when deemed to be in the
               best interests of the city. The supervisor must document the discussion and submit
               it to the human resources department within 24 hours of the discussion.
(
Ord. No. 4862
, § 1, 10-16-2023)
